name: 114 - Core - Seed Isolated Integration Test Environment - Corrected V3

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS doctor_name,
        $3::TEXT AS service_name,
        $4::TEXT AS patient_name,
        $5::TEXT AS mobile,
        $6::TEXT AS webhook_base_url,
        $7::BOOLEAN AS reset_test_data
),

updated_existing_clinic AS (
    UPDATE clinics clinic
    SET
        timezone = 'Asia/Baghdad',
        is_active = TRUE,
        description =
            'محیط ایزوله تست یکپارچه',
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                clinic.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'integration_test',
                TRUE
            ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE clinic.name =
          request.clinic_name
    RETURNING clinic.*
),

inserted_clinic AS (
    INSERT INTO clinics (
        name,
        timezone,
        is_active,
        description,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        request.clinic_name,
        'Asia/Baghdad',
        TRUE,
        'محیط ایزوله تست یکپارچه',
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM request_data request
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM updated_existing_clinic
    )
    RETURNING *
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM updated_existing_clinic

    UNION ALL

    SELECT *
    FROM inserted_clinic

    LIMIT 1
),

deleted_test_appointments AS (
    DELETE FROM appointments appointment
    USING clinic_context clinic,
          request_data request
    WHERE appointment.clinic_id = clinic.id
      AND request.reset_test_data = TRUE
      AND appointment.visit_reason =
          'integration_test_seed'
    RETURNING appointment.id
),

updated_existing_doctor AS (
    UPDATE doctors doctor
    SET
        is_active = TRUE,
        buffer_minutes = 5,
        title = COALESCE(
            doctor.title,
            'دکتر'
        ),
        specialty = COALESCE(
            doctor.specialty,
            'تخصص تست'
        ),
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                doctor.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'integration_test',
                TRUE
            ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE doctor.clinic_id =
          clinic.id
      AND doctor.full_name =
          request.doctor_name
    RETURNING doctor.*
),

inserted_doctor AS (
    INSERT INTO doctors (
        clinic_id,
        full_name,
        buffer_minutes,
        is_active,
        title,
        specialty,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        request.doctor_name,
        5,
        TRUE,
        'دکتر',
        'تخصص تست',
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM updated_existing_doctor
    )
    RETURNING *
),

doctor_context AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM updated_existing_doctor

    UNION ALL

    SELECT *
    FROM inserted_doctor

    LIMIT 1
),

updated_existing_service AS (
    UPDATE services service
    SET
        duration_minutes = 20,
        is_active = TRUE,
        description =
            'خدمت تست برای سناریوهای خودکار',
        price_amount = 10000,
        currency = 'IQD',
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                service.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                'integration_test',
                TRUE
            ),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE service.clinic_id =
          clinic.id
      AND service.name =
          request.service_name
    RETURNING service.*
),

inserted_service AS (
    INSERT INTO services (
        clinic_id,
        name,
        duration_minutes,
        is_active,
        description,
        price_amount,
        currency,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        request.service_name,
        20,
        TRUE,
        'خدمت تست برای سناریوهای خودکار',
        10000,
        'IQD',
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM updated_existing_service
    )
    RETURNING *
),

service_context AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM updated_existing_service

    UNION ALL

    SELECT *
    FROM inserted_service

    LIMIT 1
),

upsert_doctor_service AS (
    INSERT INTO doctor_services (
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        service_id,
        is_active,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        doctor.id,
        service.id,
        TRUE,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN doctor_context doctor
    CROSS JOIN service_context service
    ON CONFLICT (
        doctor_id,
        service_id
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        is_active = TRUE,
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                doctor_services.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

inserted_schedules AS (
    INSERT INTO doctor_schedules (
        doctor_id,
        weekday,
        start_time,
        end_time,
        is_active,
        valid_from,
        valid_to
    )
    SELECT
        doctor.id,
        weekday.value,
        TIME '09:00',
        TIME '17:00',
        TRUE,
        CURRENT_DATE,
        NULL
    FROM doctor_context doctor
    CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(
        1,
        7
    ) AS weekday(value)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM doctor_schedules schedule
        WHERE schedule.doctor_id =
              doctor.id
          AND schedule.weekday =
              weekday.value
          AND schedule.start_time =
              TIME '09:00'
          AND schedule.end_time =
              TIME '17:00'
          AND schedule.is_active = TRUE
    )
    RETURNING id
),

target_patient AS (
    SELECT patient.*
    FROM patients patient
    INNER JOIN clinic_context clinic
        ON patient.clinic_id =
           clinic.id
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE patient.mobile =
          request.mobile
    ORDER BY patient.id
    LIMIT 1
),

updated_existing_patient AS (
    UPDATE patients patient
    SET
        full_name =
            request.patient_name,
        is_active = TRUE,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM target_patient target
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE patient.id =
          target.id
    RETURNING patient.*
),

inserted_patient AS (
    INSERT INTO patients (
        clinic_id,
        full_name,
        mobile,
        is_active,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        request.patient_name,
        request.mobile,
        TRUE,
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM target_patient
    )
    RETURNING *
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM updated_existing_patient

    UNION ALL

    SELECT *
    FROM inserted_patient

    LIMIT 1
),

inserted_appointment AS (
    INSERT INTO appointments (
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        patient_id,
        service_id,
        starts_at,
        ends_at,
        status,
        booking_source,
        visit_reason
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        doctor.id,
        patient.id,
        service.id,

        (
            CURRENT_DATE + 1 +
            TIME '10:00'
        ) AT TIME ZONE clinic.timezone,

        (
            CURRENT_DATE + 1 +
            TIME '10:20'
        ) AT TIME ZONE clinic.timezone,

        'confirmed',
        'assistant',
        'integration_test_seed'

    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN doctor_context doctor
    CROSS JOIN patient_context patient
    CROSS JOIN service_context service
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS deleted_count
        FROM deleted_test_appointments
    ) appointment_cleanup
    RETURNING *
),

deleted_test_knowledge AS (
    DELETE FROM clinic_knowledge_entries entry
    USING clinic_context clinic,
          request_data request
    WHERE entry.clinic_id = clinic.id
      AND request.reset_test_data = TRUE
      AND entry.source_note =
          'integration_test_seed'
    RETURNING entry.id
),

inserted_knowledge AS (
    INSERT INTO clinic_knowledge_entries (
        clinic_id,
        category,
        title,
        answer_text,
        keywords,
        source_note,
        status,
        created_by,
        updated_by
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        item.category,
        item.title,
        item.answer_text,
        item.keywords,
        'integration_test_seed',
        'published',
        'integration-test-seed',
        'integration-test-seed'
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS deleted_count
        FROM deleted_test_knowledge
    ) knowledge_cleanup
    CROSS JOIN (
        VALUES
        (
            'working_hours',
            'ساعت کاری کلینیک',
            'کلینیک تست هر روز از ساعت ۹ تا ۱۷ فعال است.',
            ARRAY[
                'ساعت کاری',
                'زمان کاری',
                'working hours'
            ]::TEXT[]
        ),
        (
            'location',
            'آدرس کلینیک',
            'آدرس این محیط آزمایشی: Test Clinic Address.',
            ARRAY[
                'آدرس',
                'موقعیت',
                'location'
            ]::TEXT[]
        )
    ) AS item(
        category,
        title,
        answer_text,
        keywords
    )
    RETURNING id
),

upsert_consents AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_consents (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type,
        status,
        policy_version,
        scope_json,
        source_channel,
        granted_at,
        last_actor,
        last_reason,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        patient.id,
        consent_type.value,
        'granted',
        'integration-test-v1',
        '{}'::JSONB,
        'system',
        NOW(),
        'integration-test-seed',
        'automated_test_environment',
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN patient_context patient
    CROSS JOIN (
        VALUES
        ('contact'),
        ('appointment_reminders'),
        ('followup_messages')
    ) AS consent_type(value)
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        consent_type
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        status = 'granted',
        granted_at = NOW(),
        revoked_at = NULL,
        expires_at = NULL,
        last_actor =
            'integration-test-seed',
        last_reason =
            'automated_test_environment',
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING id
),

upsert_preference AS (
    INSERT INTO patient_communication_preferences (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel,
        enabled,
        preferred_language,
        timezone,
        quiet_hours_enabled,
        max_messages_per_week,
        metadata,
        updated_by,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        patient.id,
        'sms',
        TRUE,
        'fa',
        clinic.timezone,
        FALSE,
        100,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        'integration-test-seed',
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN patient_context patient
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        enabled = TRUE,
        preferred_language = 'fa',
        quiet_hours_enabled = FALSE,
        max_messages_per_week = 100,
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                patient_communication_preferences.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_by =
            'integration-test-seed',
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

upsert_gateway_client AS (
    INSERT INTO channel_gateway_clients (
        clinic_id,
        client_name,
        channel,
        provider_name,
        auth_mode,
        allowed_ip_addresses,
        rate_limit_requests,
        rate_limit_window_seconds,
        replay_window_seconds,
        enabled,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        'integration-webchat',
        'webchat',
        'mock-provider',
        'development_none',
        ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
        120,
        60,
        86400,
        TRUE,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        client_name,
        channel
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        provider_name =
            EXCLUDED.provider_name,
        auth_mode =
            EXCLUDED.auth_mode,
        rate_limit_requests =
            EXCLUDED.rate_limit_requests,
        rate_limit_window_seconds =
            EXCLUDED.rate_limit_window_seconds,
        replay_window_seconds =
            EXCLUDED.replay_window_seconds,
        enabled = TRUE,
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                channel_gateway_clients.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

upsert_rate_limit_client AS (
    INSERT INTO channel_gateway_clients (
        clinic_id,
        client_name,
        channel,
        provider_name,
        auth_mode,
        allowed_ip_addresses,
        rate_limit_requests,
        rate_limit_window_seconds,
        replay_window_seconds,
        enabled,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        'integration-rate-limit',
        'api',
        'mock-provider',
        'development_none',
        ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
        1,
        60,
        86400,
        TRUE,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        client_name,
        channel
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        rate_limit_requests = 1,
        rate_limit_window_seconds = 60,
        replay_window_seconds = 86400,
        enabled = TRUE,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

upsert_adapter AS (
    INSERT INTO communication_channel_adapters (
        clinic_id,
        channel,
        adapter_name,
        adapter_url,
        credential_reference,
        enabled,
        request_timeout_seconds,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    SELECT
        clinic.id,
        'sms',
        'mock-sms-adapter',
        request.webhook_base_url ||
          '/clinic/mock/channel/send',
        NULL,
        TRUE,
        30,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'integration_test',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    FROM clinic_context clinic
    CROSS JOIN request_data request
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        channel
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        adapter_name =
            EXCLUDED.adapter_name,
        adapter_url =
            EXCLUDED.adapter_url,
        enabled = TRUE,
        request_timeout_seconds = 30,
        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                communication_channel_adapters.metadata,
                '{}'::JSONB
            )
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING *
),

upsert_cases AS (
    INSERT INTO integration_test_cases (
        suite_code,
        case_code,
        title,
        category,
        enabled,
        sort_order,
        request_template,
        expected_assertions,
        metadata,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES
    (
        'mocked_e2e',
        'conversation_clinic_hours',
        'پرسش ساعت کاری از مسیر کامل مکالمه',
        'conversation',
        TRUE,
        10,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'message_text',
                'ساعت کاری کلینیک چیست؟',
            'channel',
                'webchat'
        ),
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'success',
                TRUE,
            'response_contains',
                '۹ تا ۱۷'
        ),
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'requires_mock_ai',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    ),
    (
        'mocked_e2e',
        'conversation_patient_appointments',
        'دریافت فهرست نوبت‌های بیمار',
        'conversation',
        TRUE,
        20,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'message_text',
                'نوبت‌های من را نشان بده',
            'channel',
                'webchat'
        ),
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'success',
                TRUE,
            'response_contains',
                'نوبت'
        ),
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'requires_mock_ai',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    ),
    (
        'mocked_e2e',
        'conversation_missing_information',
        'درخواست وقت بدون اطلاعات کافی',
        'conversation',
        TRUE,
        30,
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'message_text',
                'برای من یک وقت آزاد پیدا کن',
            'channel',
                'webchat'
        ),
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'success',
                TRUE,
            'conversation_status',
                'waiting_patient'
        ),
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            'requires_mock_ai',
            TRUE
        ),
        NOW()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (
        suite_code,
        case_code
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        title =
            EXCLUDED.title,
        category =
            EXCLUDED.category,
        enabled =
            EXCLUDED.enabled,
        sort_order =
            EXCLUDED.sort_order,
        request_template =
            EXCLUDED.request_template,
        expected_assertions =
            EXCLUDED.expected_assertions,
        metadata =
            EXCLUDED.metadata,
        updated_at = NOW()
    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    TRUE AS success,
    'integration_test_environment_seeded' AS result,

    clinic.id AS clinic_id,
    clinic.name AS clinic_name,
    doctor.id AS doctor_id,
    doctor.full_name AS doctor_name,
    service.id AS service_id,
    service.name AS service_name,
    patient.id AS patient_id,
    patient.full_name AS patient_name,
    patient.mobile,

    appointment.id AS appointment_id,
    appointment.starts_at AS appointment_starts_at,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upsert_gateway_client
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS gateway_client_id,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upsert_rate_limit_client
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS rate_limit_client_id,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upsert_adapter
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS adapter_id,

    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER
        FROM upsert_cases
    ) AS test_cases_upserted

FROM clinic_context clinic
CROSS JOIN doctor_context doctor
CROSS JOIN service_context service
CROSS JOIN patient_context patient
CROSS JOIN inserted_appointment appointment;

parameters.content:
## محیط تست ایزوله

این Workflow یک کلینیک تست، پزشک، خدمت، بیمار، نوبت آینده، پایگاه دانش، Consent، Gateway Client و Mock SMS Adapter می‌سازد.

نام پیش‌فرض کلینیک:
کلینیک تست یکپارچه

این داده‌ها با metadata.integration_test=true مشخص می‌شوند.

اصلاح V2:
- ON CONFLICT مربوط به clinics(name) حذف شد؛ چون Unique Constraint تضمین‌شده‌ای برای آن وجود نداشت.
- ON CONFLICT مربوط به patients(clinic_id,mobile) حذف شد.
- ساخت یا به‌روزرسانی Clinic، Doctor، Service و Patient به روش UPDATE-or-INSERT انجام می‌شود.
- CTEهای Doctor و Service اکنون رکورد تازه Insert‌شده را مستقیماً از RETURNING دریافت می‌کنند.
- درج Appointment و Knowledge بعد از Cleanup به‌صورت صریح اجرا می‌شود.

اصلاح V3:
- چهار ویرگول جاافتاده بین CTEها اضافه شد.
- محل‌های اصلاح‌شده: clinic_context، doctor_context، service_context و patient_context.
- خطای Syntax نزدیک deleted_test_appointments برطرف شد.
